skill.name: motion-graphics
skill.description: Creates short, design-led motion graphics such as kinetic typography, stat animations, chart hits, logo stings, lower thirds, article highlights, webpage callouts, and asset-fusion overlays. The workflow plans, sources needed assets, builds a HyperFrames composition, renders a short video or transparent overlay, and verifies the result.
skill.summary: Create short HyperFrames motion graphics for text, charts, logos, web pages, news, and visual callouts.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown backticks, documentation references, or browser template literals. Confirmed issues remain in helper scripts that execute local media tools, write filesystem artifacts, load public network resources, and optionally upload images to Google Gemini. No prompt-injection attempt was found in the reviewed cited files.

remediation.issue: Optional auto localization uploads image data to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before auto mode, document the upload clearly, and keep the grid-only path as the default.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts execute ffmpeg, ffprobe, base64, and ffmpeg encoding workflows on local paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate input and output paths, reject traversal in names, keep argument-array execution, and avoid processing untrusted media without confirmation.

remediation.issue: Rendering helpers depend on public CDNs, map tile servers, and atlas resources.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor or cache pinned assets when possible, document network use, and provide an offline fallback for deterministic renders.

remediation.issue: The locate helper uses a predictable /tmp font cache path.
remediation.suggestion: Use a per-run mkdtemp directory under the OS temp directory and clean it up after the helper exits.

content.value_statement: Short motion pieces need clear planning, assets, animation timing, and render checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a focused HyperFrames workflow.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests into motion categories such as kinetic type, stats, charts, logo reveal, lower thirds, news, tweets, web pages, and asset fusion.
Creates a shot plan with asset needs, category choice, layout, motion beats, palette, and HyperFrames block choices.
Uses project-local assets for search-driven work and records asset source details before composition.
Builds HyperFrames HTML compositions with a paused GSAP timeline, stable clips, and deterministic render behavior.
Supports MP4 output and transparent WebM or MOV overlay renders for short motion pieces.
Includes verification guidance for linting, inspection, repair, and final render reporting.
limitations: It is designed for short, unnarrated graphics, usually under 30 seconds.
It is not intended for long multi-scene videos, voice-over explainers, product promos, or captions on existing footage.
Search-driven categories depend on available search, capture, image, and media tooling.
Some helper scripts use local binaries and optional network APIs that need user trust and configuration.

use_cases.title: Launch a Social Stat Hit
use_cases.description: Turn one number or small dataset into a short animated stat, chart, or count-up video for social distribution.

use_cases.title: Produce Editorial Article Highlights
use_cases.description: Animate a news headline, key phrase, outlet mark, and supporting image into a short readable editorial graphic.

use_cases.title: Create Product UI Callouts
use_cases.description: Capture a web page or dashboard and animate scrolls, cursor actions, highlights, and labels around real interface elements.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Simple Headline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short kinetic typography motion graphic for this headline: [headline]. Use a 9:16 format and keep it under 8 seconds.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Stat Animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short motion graphic for this metric: [metric and context]. Show the number clearly, add one supporting label, and render an MP4.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Web Page Highlight
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short webpage highlight for [URL or product page]. Capture the page, animate the important section, and add one precise callout.

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Asset-Fusion Overlay
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an asset-fusion motion graphic using [image or subject] and [data point]. Ground the target geometry, fuse the data into the asset, and render a transparent overlay.

output_examples.input: A founder quote needs a 6 second social graphic.
output_examples.output: A vertical kinetic typography video with staged word reveals, one emphasis beat, and a final hold for the quote attribution.

output_examples.input: A product team wants to show a dashboard metric rising this quarter.
output_examples.output: A short dashboard-style motion graphic with a count-up KPI, staggered supporting cards, and an animated chart panel.

output_examples.input: A web page feature needs a quick launch highlight.
output_examples.output: A captured page animation with a controlled scroll, cursor click, spotlight wipe, and anchored label on the target element.

best_practices: Choose one motion message before sourcing assets or selecting a category.
Freeze all sourced media into the project folder before composition.
Run lint, inspect, and a draft render before reporting the final video.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for narrated explainers or long multi-scene videos.
Do not rely on remote URLs inside the final render composition.
Do not eyeball geometry when the workflow provides a locate protocol.

faq.question: What kinds of videos does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates short motion-first graphics such as animated text, stats, charts, logo stings, lower thirds, and callouts.

faq.question: Can it create transparent overlays?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports transparent WebM or MOV output when the project is configured as an alpha overlay.

faq.question: Does it support real web pages or news items?
faq.answer: Yes. Search-driven categories can capture pages, articles, tweets, or images, then animate project-local copies.

faq.question: Does it require API keys?
faq.answer: Most core flows do not require keys. Some search, generation, or optional detector paths may use configured provider keys.

faq.question: What tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects HyperFrames, Node, ffmpeg, and related local rendering tools to be available in the agent environment.

faq.question: When should I use another video skill?
faq.answer: Use another workflow for narrated videos, product promos, topic explainers, long edits, or captions on existing footage.
